system.description:
When you strike a creature, you leave behind a small bone fragment inside of them that you then cause to grow and expand.

As a part of the same action used to cast another Kaguya clan Hijutsu that deals damage or deal [Weapon Damage] or [Unarmed Damage] with a Bone Weapon, you can cast this jutsu forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save you leave behind the bone fragment. On a success you are unable to leave it behind.

A creature who failed their Constitution saving throw begins to experience their internal organs being stabbed by the growing bone mass, taking 5d8 Piercing damage that ignore damage reduction and cannot be resisted.

For the next minute, at the Beginning of the affected creatures turn they remake this saving throw, 3d8 Necrotic damage on a failed save or no damage on a success. A creature can spend their Action to attempt to dig out this fragmented bone from their body by making a Strength (Medicine) check vs this jutsu’s Save DC. On a success, they forcibly removing it. A creature can only be under the effects of this jutsu once at any given time.

Battle Lust: By spending 2 Battle Lust when a creature fails their saving throw at the beginning of their turn, they also gain 1 rank of Bleed.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If cast at A-Rank increase the damage by 1d8.
